title: Page 8
content_zh:
“啊？你刚才在说什么？我没听清楚！”言待榆看他一眼，“你最近好常来这边。”
“谢谢你上次的帮忙，这是要给你的。”林颜强将手中精美包装的礼物递到她的面前，包装纸只沾了一点水，被保护得很好。
“你要不要用毛巾擦一下，不然要是感冒就不好了。”言待榆走到休息室，拿出一条干净的毛巾递给他。
“好。”林颜强忍不住多闻了几下毛巾的味道，“这是你的毛巾吗？”好香。
“不是，是我们老板的，虽然他用过，但毛巾是洗过的，你放心。”
林颜强的脑中瞬间浮现出一名中年男子的面貌，嘴角不禁微微抽动了一下。
“怎么了？你刚才要拿给我什么东西？”她没注意看。
“这是送你的。”再次将礼物递到她面前。
“不用了啦——”她又不缺东西，“你把礼物送给别人比较实在。”送她她又不见得喜欢。
“礼物你还是收下吧！这是我的一点心意，你不收，我也只能丢掉。”
“里面是什么？”她纯粹好奇地问。
“包包。”爱马仕的柏金包。
“我又不缺包包。”
“还是你喜欢什么？我再去买。”
“不用了，林颜强，朋友之间帮忙是应该的，你送礼反而显得很奇怪耶！”麻烦死了。
被训了一顿，林颜强仍是不死心道：“你就收下吧！还是你需要什么？”
“我现在需要的不是礼物。”而是友情。
“你需要什么？”
“罗曼曼在生我的气，而我现在只想跟她和好。”还有殷策也是，她瞄了林颜强一眼，“你不回去换衣服吗？”这样不会很难过吗？
“不要紧。”他现在有更重要的事要做。

那他可不可以不要打扰她工作呢？她心情恶劣的很想脱口而出。
“对了，上次我送你回去，那个男人是你哥哥吗？你和他住一起是吗？”他再次问出心里很在意的问题。
“之前是因为有一些原因才会住在他那里，我们只是朋友。”她落寞的说。
“是普通朋友嘛？”
“现在连朋友也当不成了吧！”她越想越难过。
“为什么？”闻言他的心中一喜，看来自己很有机会。
言待榆看着他许久，最后还是把话给吞回去，“没为什么。”
“谢谢。”她听了却是一点也开心不起来。
“她想再约你到我家吃饭。”
“就你妈跟我吗？”这样不会很奇怪吗？
“你希望我也去吗？”他期盼的问。
“该不会是你妈想拿钱要我滚远一点，说我配不上你，说你已经和谁谁谁有婚配之类的话吧！”就是那种常发生在有钱人家的老套戏码。
“你怎么会配不上我？而且我也没有婚配。”他赶忙澄清。
“我当然只是随口说说。”竟然会有人把她的话给当真，“林颜强，你怎么变笨了？”
“那……你要来吗？”他可以带她回家，让她参观一下他住的地方，让她知道他有能力给她安定与优渥的生活。
“不了，麻烦你跟伯母说谢谢她的好意，我怕如果真的去了，就得跟你交往了。”上次帮忙他骗了他的父母一次，她已经有些良心不安了。
“不行吗？”他试探的问。
她睨了他一眼，“不要开玩笑了。”
“还是我请你去吃顿饭。”带她去一间气氛浪漫的餐厅，或许她一个动心，便答应跟他交往了。
“不用。”她现在是失婚妇女，好友又在生她的气，她才没那个心情；她送着餐点，看着时间，准备要下班。

“我送你回去。”
“我有骑机车来。”她说得有些心酸——想到之前还有个坏心但温柔的司机来接送她。
下班时间一到，言待榆走到休息室，与同事签了交接日记后，拿着包包，准备回家；走到外面，雨势转大，她皱了眉，走入雨中，发现林颜强也跟着走出来，她转头看向他，“你还有事吗？”拿出雨衣套上。
“我上次要告诉你的事还没说完。”
“下雨了，我没有雨伞，你会感冒的。”她无奈的看着他。
林颜强听出了她的关心，心一暖，笑道：“没关系。”雨打在他的身上，他一点也不觉得冷，“我想跟你说，我是真的很喜欢你。”
她眉头紧皱，他怎么还没死心？“谢谢你的厚爱，但是我们不适合。”她一点部不想在这里跟他演八点档，“你快进去。”
“怎么会？我觉得你很有趣、很直爽，是我理想中的女人。”他很肯定的说。
“我对你没有那种感觉。”她一直把他当成是朋友。
“那你喜欢哪一型的男友？我可以改。”
她脑海中浮现殷策的脸孔，下一秒又忍不住暗自骂自己没志气，“这不是改不改的问题，你就是你，不必为了谁去改变自己。”
林颜强点头，“我就是欣赏你的这种想法。”
“不是只有我这么认为，是真的。”这种想法一点也不特别。
“你讨厌我吗？”自从他没再找罗曼曼后，她对他的态度变得友善许多，他还以为她多少对他是有感觉的。
“我把你当朋友，有的只是友谊。”
“那就表示我还有机会。”
“你是听不懂中文吗？”没关系，她可以再翻译一次，“我只会把你当成朋友。”
“好吧！那我们就从朋友当起，我相信你有一天终究会被我感动的。”
言待榆面部抽搐，久久说不出话来，他是打哪来的自信？
“林颜强，大鱼只想跟你当朋友而已，你是听不懂吗？”罗曼曼撑着伞，快步走了过来，站在言待榆面前。

言待榆看着熟悉、娇小的身影，心里是又惊又喜，“罗曼曼——”
“曼曼，你终于出现了！”一回到住处，言待榆就开心的抱着好友笑道。
“大鱼，你好丢脸。”罗曼曼笑道，她才发个脾气，言待榆就这么紧张，但这也让她很开心，原来大鱼比想像中还在意她。
“你不生气了？”言待榆盯着她的笑脸，心里仍是不安。
“殷策先生打电话给我，说你看我生气了，整个人又慌又急。”罗曼曼噗嗤笑出声，“听说还跑到他那里去求救。”
“哪有很慌很急，那是夸张的说法啦！”她面子挂不住的强辩，“你干嘛连我的电话都不接？”
“就气你啊！这种大事都可以瞒我这么久。”她那天知道消息后，还回家大哭了一场。
“所以殷策打电话给你，你才过来找我？”她没想到殷策会替她做这些事。
罗曼曼撑着面颊，“殷先生对你真好。”
“对啊！”她心里有着淡淡的甜蜜——他没想像中的无情。
“林颜强对你也不错，还雨中告白呢！”罗曼曼笑道：“你最近的桃花真旺。”
“干嘛提到林颜强！”她也被他突如其来的告白给吓了一跳，她真的有这么好吗？才约会一次，林颜强就这么死心的认定她是他的真命天女。
“你很久都没叫他香肠了，该不会是对他改观了吧？”罗曼曼探问：“刚才他那样，你难道一点都不动心吗？”
“其实他也算是个不错的朋友。”她很认真的的说。
“但你还是比较喜欢殷先生。”罗曼曼观察着好友的神情，笑说道：“我说中了吗？”
“有什么用，我们以后连朋友都当不成！”其实她也搞不懂他的想法，既然不想跟她当朋友，为什么又要帮她？
“所以你要放弃他了？”
“不然还能怎样？”
唉！殷策听到这句话，一定又会气到吐血，罗曼曼忍不住这么想着。
content_en:
"Ah? What were you talking about just now? I didn't hear clearly!" Yan Daiyu glanced at him, "You've been here a lot lately."
"Thank you for your help last time. This is for you." Lin Yanqiang handed the beautifully wrapped gift in front of her. The wrapping paper was only stained with a little water and was well protected.
"Do you want to wipe it with a towel, otherwise it will be bad if you catch a cold." Yan Daiyu walked to the lounge and took out a clean towel and handed it to him.
"Okay." Lin Yanqiang couldn't help but smell the towel a few more times, "Is this your towel?" It smelled so good.
"No, it belongs to our boss. Although he has used it, the towel has been washed. Don't worry."
The face of a middle-aged man suddenly appeared in Lin Yanqiang's mind, and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
"What's wrong? What did you want to bring me just now?" She didn't pay attention.
"This is for you." He handed the gift to her again.
"No need -" she didn't lack anything, "it would be more practical if you gave the gift to someone else." She might not like it if you give it to her.
"You should accept the gift! This is a little bit of my heart. If you don't accept it, I can only throw it away."
"What's inside?" she asked out of sheer curiosity.
"Bag." Hermès Birkin bag.
"I'm not short of bags."
"What do you like? I'll buy it again."
"No, Lin Yanqiang, friends should help each other, but it seems weird for you to give gifts!" It's so troublesome.
After being scolded, Lin Yanqiang still refused to give up and said: "Just accept it! Or do you need something?"
"What I need now is not gifts." But friendship.
"What do you need?"
"Romanman is angry with me, and now I just want to make peace with her." Yin Ce did the same. She glanced at Lin Yanqiang and said, "Why don't you go back and change clothes?" Wouldn't that be sad?
"It doesn't matter." He has more important things to do now.
Then can he not disturb her work? She was in such a bad mood that she wanted to blurt it out.
"By the way, last time I sent you back, was that man your brother? Do you live with him?" He asked the question that was very important to him again.
"I stayed with him for some reasons before. We were just friends." She said lonely.
"Are they just ordinary friends?"
"We can't even be friends now!" The more she thought about it, the sadder she became.
"Why?" Hearing this, he felt happy. It seemed that he had a good chance.
Yan Daiyu looked at him for a long time, and finally swallowed his words, "No reason."
"Thank you." She was not happy at all after hearing this.
"She wants to invite you to my house for dinner again."
"Is it just your mother and me?" Isn't this weird?
"Do you want me to go too?" he asked expectantly.
"Could it be that your mother wants to pay me to go away, saying that I'm not good enough for you, saying that you're already married to so-and-so?" It's the kind of old-fashioned drama that often happens in rich families.
"How could you not be worthy of me? And I'm not married either." He quickly clarified.
"Of course I was just talking casually." Someone actually took her words seriously, "Lin Yanqiang, why have you become stupid?"
"Then...are you coming?" He can take her home, let her visit the place where he lives, and let her know that he has the ability to give her a stable and comfortable life.
"No, please tell your aunt to thank her for her kindness. I'm afraid that if I really go, I will have to date you." She helped him deceive his parents last time, and she already had some uneasy conscience.
"No?" he asked tentatively.
She glanced at him and said, "Stop joking."
"I'd better treat you to a meal." Take her to a restaurant with a romantic atmosphere. Maybe she will be tempted and agree to date him.
"No need." She is a divorced woman now, and her friends are angry with her, so she doesn't have the heart to do so.Love; she delivered the meal, looked at the time, and prepared to get off work.
"I'll take you back."
"I came on a motorcycle." She said a little sadly - thinking of a bad-hearted but gentle driver who came to pick her up before.
As soon as the off-duty time came, Yan Daiyu walked to the lounge, signed the handover diary with her colleagues, took her bag, and prepared to go home. When she walked outside, the rain became heavier. She frowned, walked into the rain, and found that Lin Yanqiang was also walking out. She turned to look at him, "Are you okay?" She took out her raincoat and put it on.
"I haven't finished what I wanted to tell you last time."
"It's raining. I don't have an umbrella. You will catch a cold." She looked at him helplessly.
Lin Yanqiang heard her concern, his heart warmed, and he smiled and said, "It doesn't matter." The rain hit him, and he didn't feel cold at all. "I want to tell you that I really like you."
She frowned, why hasn't he given up yet? "Thank you for your kindness, but we are not suitable." She didn't want to play the eight o'clock show with him here at all, "You go in quickly."
"How is that possible? I think you are very interesting and straightforward, and you are my ideal woman." He said with certainty.
"I don't feel that way about you." She always considered him a friend.
"What kind of boyfriend do you like? I can change it."
Yin Ce's face appeared in her mind, and the next second she couldn't help scolding herself for having no ambition, "It's not a question of whether to change or not. You are who you are, and you don't have to change yourself for anyone."
Lin Yanqiang nodded, "I just appreciate your idea."
"I'm not the only one who thinks that. It's true." There's nothing special about this idea.
"Do you hate me?" Since he stopped looking for Roman Man, her attitude towards him had become much friendlier, and he thought she had some feelings for him.
"I treat you as a friend, just friendship."
"That means I still have a chance."
"Don't you understand Chinese?" It doesn't matter, she can translate again, "I will only treat you as a friend."
"Okay! Then let's start as friends. I believe you will be moved by me one day."
Yan Taiyu's face twitched and he was speechless for a long time. Where did he get his confidence?
"Lin Yanqiang, Da Yu just wants to be friends with you, don't you understand?" Luo Manman walked over quickly, holding an umbrella, and stood in front of Yan Daiyu.
Yan Taiyu looked at the familiar and petite figure, feeling surprised and happy, "Romanman——"
"Manman, you finally showed up!" As soon as he returned to his residence, Yan Daiyu happily hugged his friend and laughed.
"Big Fish, you're so embarrassed." Luo Manman said with a smile. She just lost her temper. Yan Taiyu was so nervous, but it also made her very happy. It turned out that Big Fish cared about her more than she thought.
"Are you not angry anymore?" Yan Taiyu stared at her smiling face, still feeling uneasy.
"Mr. Yin Ce called me and said you saw that I was angry and that I was panicking and anxious." Romanman chuckled, "I heard that I even ran to him for help."
"There's no way you're panicked or anxious. That's an exaggeration!" She argued in a dignified tone, "Why didn't you even answer my call?"
"I'm so angry with you! You could hide such a big thing from me for so long." After she found out the news that day, she went home and burst into tears.
"So Yin Ce called you and you came to see me?" She didn't expect Yin Ce to do these things for her.
Romanman held up his cheeks and said, "Mr. Yin is so kind to you."
"Yes!" There was a touch of sweetness in her heart - he was not as ruthless as he had imagined.
"Lin Yanqiang is also very kind to you. He even confessed to you in the rain!" Luo Manman said with a smile: "You have been really prosperous recently."
"Why did you mention Lin Yanqiang!" She was also shocked by his sudden confession. Is she really that good? After just one date, Lin Yanqiang was so determined that she was his rightful daughter.
"You haven't called him sausage for a long time. Could it be that you have changed your mind about him?"Already? Roman Man asked: "Weren't you not moved at all by what he did just now?" "
“Actually, he’s a pretty good friend. "She said seriously.
“But you still prefer Mr. Yin. Romanman observed his friend's expression and said with a smile, "Did I hit the mark?" "
"What's the use, we can't even be friends in the future! "Actually, she didn't understand what he was thinking. Since he didn't want to be her friend, why did he help her?
"So you're giving up on him? "
"What else could happen? "
Alas! When Yin Ce heard this, he would be so angry that he vomited blood again, Romanman couldn't help but think so.
